title: docs(pm-dispatch): four-axis decision analysis switches to Chinese (comments + facets blocks)
body:
Fixes #9983

## What

Maintainer ruling (2026-08-19, verbatim, untranslated): 「要求以后issue中的四维分析也用中文写」. The four-axis decision analysis left on GitHub — the analysis comment and the `os-decision-facets` card-face block — switches to Chinese. Governed surface (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`): draft PR, human merge.

- **Language policy** (`SKILL.md`, 全体座位的不变量): the Chinese channels grow from two to three — round report (chat), ruling quotes in dispatch prompts, and now the decision four-axis analysis (comment + facets block), recorded with the ruling date and verbatim quote. New-records-only: existing English blocks are not migrated.
- **Escalation flow step ②** (`SKILL.md`): analysis comment 「英文」→「中文」.
- **Facets block shape** (`SKILL.md`): the machine marker stays byte-stable (it appears only as diff context; extraction greps the literal). The four facet lines go Chinese, labels included: 项目长远合理性 / 实际业务拉动 / 防 AI 犯错 / 创业阶段不扩散, each keeping its original gloss.
- **Decision-inbox backfill duty** (`SKILL.md`): blocks written by backfill from now on are Chinese; existing English blocks are not rewritten.
- **`references/dispatch-runbook.md`**: the analysis-template annotation flips 「英文」→「中文,2026-08-19 裁」 (net-zero lines; the file sits at headroom 0 and the verbatim quote lives in SKILL.md, which the runbook line is a detail of).

## Consumer check for the English axis labels (decides label language, per the card)

Grepped `scripts/` (recursively, incl. `scripts/pm/`), `.claude/`, `.github/`, and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/` for the literal `os-decision-facets` and the four English labels.

- `os-decision-facets`: zero hits outside the SKILL.md sentence being edited — no extraction script in the repo greps the labels; extraction is pinned to the marker only.
- Axis-label text: the only script hit is `scripts/check-skill-frame-sync.mjs` (`AXIS_MAP` regex for `startup scope discipline` plus two self-test literals). That gate watches the four escalation-frame copies; the internal PM copy is declared `lang: 'zh'` and its extracted section (start/binding anchors) ends before the facets block, so the facets lines are outside its scan. Measured, not argued: `check:skill-frame-sync` is green on this tree, where the facets block no longer contains any English axis label — had the gate been reading that block as a frame copy, this edit would have turned it red.
- `references/` (triage confidence-gate text included): zero hits.

No consumers ⇒ per the card, labels go Chinese too.

| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 680 | 681 | 682 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` | 223 | 223 | 223 |

The +1 line is the language-policy exception record (ruling date + verbatim quote); all other edits are net-zero. No re-wrap of untouched text.

Derivation: "2 path(s) vs merge base 6de17ea93 of 'origin/main' and HEAD", 7 families matched. All run at `223e912a2`, exit codes captured before any pipe (`cmd > log 2>&1; EXIT=$?`):

Named beyond the derivation: `check:skill-compatibility` EXIT=0 — "11 pinned major(s) all match the workspace"; `check:nul-bytes` EXIT=0 — "OK (scanned 6340 text file(s) … no raw ASCII control bytes)".

## Reverse verification (directions predicted before running)

1. **Ratchet ablation** — predicted red. Appended 2 throwaway lines (683 lines) → `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` EXIT=1: "✗ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md is 683 lines; the ratchet ceiling is 682." Restored via `git checkout` of the file from the committed branch; byte-identical proof: `git hash-object` on the working-tree file equals the HEAD blob id, both `c975dba8b42c76332680017048c348ec67725c62`; gate green again (681/682). No build step involved — the gate reads the file directly, no dist to rebuild.
2. **Marker stability** — predicted 1 literal hit, untouched. `grep -c os-decision-facets` = 1; `git diff HEAD~1 HEAD` has 0 `+`/`-` lines containing the marker (context only).
3. **Frame-sync as consumer measurement** — predicted green-stays-green: the facets block lost all four English axis labels and `check:skill-frame-sync` stayed green with "4 axes: business-need → long-term-soundness → ai-authoring-safety → startup-scope-discipline", confirming the gate reads the escalation-frame copies (unchanged, zh section anchors intact), not the facets block.

## Out of scope

- Existing English facets blocks on open decision cards remain as-is (new-records-only, per the card).
- Triage audit comments (「Triage: lands in …」), claim comments, and the machine criterion `Clause-②: yes|no` stay English — they are not the four-axis analysis.
- Sibling escalation-frame copies (`.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, published `skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`) untouched; frame-sync pins them.

No changeset: `.claude/` instruction surface only, nothing published — `skip-changeset` applied.
